explanation: Checked physicality: eta-production threshold is W_min = m_p + m_eta = 0.938272 + 0.54786 = 1.486132 GeV (eta/exclurad.F setcon: amhad(1)=0.938272 for the detected proton, amunm(1)=0.54786 for the recoil eta, ivec=1). The requested W = 1.52 GeV is ~34 MeV above threshold, i.e. 'comfortably above threshold' as stated. I verified the radiative-integration upper bound vmax = W^2 - m_eta^2 + m_p^2 - 2*W*m_p (eta/exclurad.F:253) evaluates to +0.0382 GeV^2 at this point, confirming the phase space is open and the point is physical (a negative vmax would indicate a kinematically forbidden point). cos(theta*) = -0.4 and phi* = 45 deg are within their allowed ranges [-1,1] and [0,360) deg, and Q^2 = 0.6 GeV^2, W = 1.52 GeV both lie inside the EtaMAID-2023 table grid (Q^2: 0-5 GeV^2, W: 1.4856-6 GeV; eta/mpintp.inc). No corrections were required; this is a single point (N=1) so no chunking is needed. Used the eta configuration (model=3 maid2000/EtaMAID, ivec=1 detected proton, lepton=1 electron), CLAS12 beam momentum bmom=6.535 GeV and vcut=0.166 GeV^2 from the repo's template input.dat/README defaults (the README text elsewhere rounds this to 6.53; either is a negligible ~0.1% difference and does not affect the physicality of this point). Full O(alpha) mode (rc_mode=0) was selected per the template. The input file is ready to run as `./build/exclurad.exe < eta_input_W1.52_Q0.6_ct-0.4_phi45.dat` once compiled (no compiler is available in this session, so the run itself was not executed).
